'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Matt Schmaltz DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Schmaltz]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]]
* '''Username:''' Dashmudtz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
